independence_basis: This frame classifies R&D by knowledge domain. Its primary classification object differs from kind of economic activity (ISIC), patent technology (IPC), and government expenditure purpose (COFOG). Structural independence is recorded for candidate generation; substantive independence remains reviewable at scientific review.
audit_note: OECD identifies the Frascati Manual 2015 as the current edition as of the Task 103 registration date. The Manual proposes the OECD FORD classification for classification and distribution of R&D by field.
